title: Ecosystem — Portaless, Verared, Gerarion & Tokenless
description: How Portaless, Verared, Gerarion, and Tokenless connect: purpose, architecture, and roadmap of all four creations.

props.title: The ecosystem: four modular pieces built to work together
props.subtitle: Each project solves a focused layer without forcing a monolith. Adopt a single piece or combine them as your site or product grows.

props.text: Portaless is a lightweight Astro CMS that compiles to static HTML while offering an optional dynamic runtime (Node/Docker or Cloudflare Pages + D1) with a native visual editor (17 Atomic Elements), live editable home page (/), strict CSP without unsafe-inline, native MCP server (19 tools), and sandboxed plugins with atomic permissions.
2. Verared — Vera Trust Stack & agent protocol

Verared packages the cryptographic and protocol primitives into 7 standalone npm packages under @verared/* (net, apw, local-trust, reputation, trust-layer, cloud-images, and identity-atproto). Any node can verify did:apw identity, validate Web Bot Auth signatures, and enforce local trust policies without a central gatekeeper.
